reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 12 points better, in a game of about 240 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Nuggets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 85 times in 100, by about 14; most games like this end between 211 and 260 total points.

analyst.text: New Orleans are in turmoil: Dejounte Murray has asked for a trade, the club confirmed it, and Shams Charania reports he will not be playing for the Pelicans going forward, after he posted and deleted a tweet claiming "sabotage". Columns point to disinterest during a four-game skid that included a franchise-record 51-point loss, and coach Jamahl Mosley's job is being questioned. The Pelicans were also beaten 142-111 by Memphis on Friday, the first night of a back-to-back. Denver arrive rested and winners of five of their last seven, so the news angle leans clearly towards the Nuggets.
